boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus settings for collaborating, taking a break, moving around, or catching arts and recreation activity.

cards.title: Dionne Green
cards.subtitle: Central campus lawn
cards.notes: Bring a classmate, a blanket, or a low-key activity between classes; use the open lawn as a simple outdoor reset when conditions allow.
cards.short_summary: A named green space used for class gatherings and outdoor student activity.
cards.evidence_claim: University reporting documents incoming-class gatherings, lawn games and students doing schoolwork on Dionne Green.
cards.source_title: Nearly 1500 New Royals Begin Scranton Journey
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; follow posted event and weather guidance.

cards.title: The DeNaples Center Patio
cards.subtitle: Outdoor seating at the DeNaples Center
cards.notes: Use the umbrella-table seating for a conversation or a breather between commitments; leave reserved tables available during the school year.
cards.short_summary: An accessible patio with seasonal tables and chairs beside the student center.
cards.evidence_claim: The University lists patio tables with umbrellas and chairs in warmer months and notes that five tables are reserved through Student Affairs during the school year.
cards.access_notes: Accessible; table availability may be affected by Student Affairs reservations.

cards.title: Reilly Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Weinberg Memorial Library, first floor
cards.notes: Reserve a group room before meeting up, or use a first-come collaboration pod for a shared screen and laptop-based project work.
cards.short_summary: A technology-equipped library commons designed around group work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Reilly Learning Commons has group study rooms, collaboration pods, computers, and reservable rooms for groups of five to seven students.
cards.access_notes: Group rooms are reservable; the library recommends reserving even if a room appears empty.

cards.title: Pro Deo Room
cards.subtitle: Weinberg Memorial Library, first floor
cards.notes: Choose this first-floor library room for a brief conversational study session; keep calls and video chats contained to designated areas.
cards.short_summary: A designated library space where conversation and video chats are permitted.
cards.evidence_claim: Library policy identifies the Pro Deo Room as a first-floor area where cell-phone and video-chat conversations are permitted.
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to library conduct policies; after-hours first-floor access is limited to current students, faculty and staff.

cards.title: Media Lounge
cards.subtitle: Weinberg Memorial Library
cards.notes: Coordinate a club or class viewing session and submit a request for the intended time, especially when planning to use the room together.
cards.short_summary: A library room available around the clock for shared media viewing.
cards.evidence_claim: Library policy states that the Media Lounge is open 24/7 and sets a process for class or club requests to meet there for media viewing.
cards.access_notes: The Media Lounge is open 24/7; requests should be made for class or club use.

cards.title: Pilarz Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Rev. Scott R. Pilarz, S.J., Hall
cards.notes: Plan a workout with a friend or attend around your class schedule; bring your Royal ID and follow the facility’s current operating rules.
cards.short_summary: A campus fitness facility with cardio equipment, weight machines and free weights.
cards.evidence_claim: University reporting identifies a 14,000-square-foot fitness center in Pilarz Hall with cardio equipment, weight machines, free weights and a multi-use CrossFit station.
cards.source_title: Scranton Among the 50 Fittest Colleges in America
cards.access_notes: Campus facility access is controlled; verify current hours and eligibility before going.

cards.title: Byron Recreation Complex
cards.subtitle: Campus recreation and intramural facilities
cards.notes: Check the recreation schedule for a pickup-style activity, fitness class, or intramural event, and meet your group at the complex.
cards.short_summary: The campus hub for intramural gym space, a pool and recreation programming.
cards.evidence_claim: The University states that the Byron Recreation Complex houses intramural gymnasium facilities, a pool and athletic offices.
cards.access_notes: Programs and facility access vary; consult current recreation information before arrival.

cards.title: Hope Horn Gallery
cards.subtitle: Hyland Hall, fourth floor
cards.notes: Drop in during posted gallery hours to look through the current exhibition, or pair a visit with a campus arts event or a conversation nearby.
cards.short_summary: A fourth-floor campus gallery with rotating exhibitions during the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: The University says the Hope Horn Gallery is on the fourth floor of Hyland Hall and displays exhibitions throughout the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Current gallery hours are Sunday–Friday, noon–4 p.m., plus Wednesday 6–8 p.m.; confirm exhibit dates before visiting.

cards.title: Christ the Teacher Sculpture
cards.subtitle: At the bottom of the Commons
cards.notes: Use the stone base as a short outdoor pause point while moving through the Commons, and take a moment to notice the interactive public artwork.
cards.short_summary: A named campus sculpture with a stone base at the bottom of the Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: The University describes “Christ the Teacher” as an interactive sculpture at the bottom of the Commons and notes that people sit on its stone base.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public artwork; keep pathways clear and respect the installation.

cards.title: Chapel of the Sacred Heart
cards.subtitle: Named campus chapel
cards.notes: Check the campus ministry calendar before stopping in for a service, reflection, or quiet moment, and observe the chapel’s current access expectations.
cards.short_summary: A named chapel that serves as a campus spiritual-life destination.
cards.evidence_claim: The University’s current campus map lists the Chapel of the Sacred Heart as a campus structure.
cards.access_notes: Access and services may vary; check current Campus Ministries information before visiting.
